input:
Earlier scenes:
(none)

This scene:
古代的时候，孟子和孟母住了在靠墓地的家。孩子才五岁就每天在墓地祭拜了。在那个城市，孟母从早到晚都找工作，可是找不到，害得孟母没有钱。难怪她跟孩子搬家，原来买不了房。他们搬了到别一个城市找工作。

The teacher's corrections on this scene (student words：her correction, her note):
- 古代的时候，孟子和孟母住了在靠墓地的家：在古代，better to briefly introduce “孟子” when this character first appears；住在靠近墓地的地方/墓地附近，delete了，在+Place
- 孩子才五岁就每天在墓地祭拜了：孟子，孩子is vague and unclear
- 难怪她跟孩子搬家，原来买不了房：wrong information, 搬家因为孟母觉得it is not good to imitate how to offer sacrifices
- 他们搬了到别一个城市找工作：搬到了，另外一个城市，“别（的）” is for “a different type”, and “all else except the spoken one”, whereas “另外“ is for “addition in quantity”, and “another, the other”

The system's feedback items:
1. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 古代的时候：在古代，the phrase is redundant because 古代 already expresses a time period, while 的时候 also means “at the time of.”
2. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 靠墓地的家：靠近墓地的家里，use 靠近 to describe proximity, and use 家里 as the location where someone lives.
3. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 跟孩子搬家：带着孟子搬家，跟孟子搬家 means that both people move together as equal participants; 带着孟子搬家 correctly shows that the mother takes her child with her.
4. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 别一个城市：另一个城市，use 另一个 for “another one”; 别的 is normally used before a noun to mean “other/different.”
5. [Coherence: reference, error] Coherence (Reference): 孟子和孟母：有一个小男孩叫孟子，他和妈妈，at first mention, briefly introduce the main character with his identity before using the names or family role.
6. [Coherence: reference, error] Coherence (Reference): 孩子才五岁：他才五岁，use a pronoun for a close re-occurrence when the referent is clear and no other male character competes with it.
7. [Coherence: reference, error] Coherence (Reference): 在那个城市：在一个城市里，this is the first mention of a city, so use a full noun phrase rather than the demonstrative phrase 那个城市, whose referent has not been introduced.
8. [Coherence: temporality, error] Coherence (Temporality): 住了在：住在，住 is a continuing state here, so it takes the zero particle rather than 了.
9. [Coherence: temporality, error] Coherence (Temporality): 每天在墓地祭拜了：每天在墓地祭拜，every day marks a routine, so use the zero particle rather than completed-action 了.
10. [Coherence: temporality, error] Coherence (Temporality): 她跟孩子搬家：她带着孟子搬家了，this move has already happened, so completed-action 了 is needed at the end of the verb phrase.
11. [Coherence: temporality, error] Coherence (Temporality): 他们搬了到：他们搬到了，when a verb is followed by the resultative/directional complement 到, place 了 after the complement: 搬到了.

items.reason: 古代已经表示时间，古代的时候在这里重复了。
这里应说靠近墓地，改成靠近墓地的家里可以表示居住地点。
跟孩子搬家本身可以自然地表示母亲和孩子一起搬家，并不必然表示两人地位相等。
表示另一个城市应使用另一个，而不是别一个。
首次出现孟子时需要简要介绍，但“有一个小男孩叫孟子，他和妈妈”不是完整句子。
孩子在此指代不够明确，紧接前文用他可以清楚指孟子。
城市首次出现时不宜直接说那个城市，改为一个城市里可以首次引入它。
住表示持续状态，不能用住了在；但单独的“住在”仍缺少地点补足语。
每天表示习惯性动作，祭拜后不应加完成体了。
孩子的指代不够明确，而叙述中这次搬家已发生，带着孟子搬家了是正确的改法。
了应放在趋向补语到之后，但单独的“他们搬到了”仍缺少目的地。
